---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an option, an SVG feature to support, or a better default
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What do you want to do?**

Describe the job, for example "export Inkscape layers as separate DXF files".

**Why is it useful?**

Which program or machine needs it, and what you do today instead.

**Example**

A small SVG and the DXF result you would expect, if you can share one.

**Alternatives you considered**

Other options or workarounds you tried.
